description: This file defines functions and constants related to session identifiers in an ACP runtime, including resolving session lines, handling agent hints, and managing session metadata.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Normalizes input to a trimmed string or undefined if not a string.

methods.name: normalizeAgentHintKey
methods.description: Normalizes agent hint keys by trimming, converting to lowercase, and replacing spaces/underscores with hyphens.

methods.name: resolveAcpAgentResumeHintLine
methods.description: Resolves a resume hint line based on agent ID and session ID.

methods.name: resolveAcpSessionIdentifierLines
methods.description: Generates session identifier lines based on session key and metadata.

methods.name: resolveAcpSessionIdentifierLinesFromIdentity
methods.description: Generates session lines from identity object and mode.

methods.name: resolveAcpSessionCwd
methods.description: Resolves the current working directory from session metadata.

methods.name: resolveAcpThreadSessionDetailLines
methods.description: Generates detailed session lines for thread mode, including resume hints.
